QuestInfo.name: Smithing Meister
QuestInfo.0: Grant wants to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: There's more to Smithing than you ever realized!
QuestInfo.2: Make crafting your passion in life!

0.msg: You have become a Craftsman. Very good, very good!

1.msg: Now, you must reach for Meister, the untrodden path! I will tell you all I know!

0.msg: Wrong choice, wrong choice! You need my help!

1.0: Ah, ah! You are here! You are here!

0.msg: I will tell you the ways of a Meister!

1.msg: Meisters are more skilled than Craftsman, but the path is not easy. Oh, no! It will require tears and blood! You must craft #bequipment that is Lv. 8 or above#k! Or #brare items that need recipes#k!

2.msg: The difference is, you must craft more. Much more! It will seem endless, but the rewards will be worth it!

3.msg: Meisters can craft #bequipment and items with unheard of stats#k that are better than anything anyone has ever seen! Meisters have #bweeded out low-rank Bonus Stats#k, too.\nYou'll see that #bperformance of the Weapon Refinement skill you currently have has improved#k.\r\n

4.msg: Next time we speak, I hope I can call you Meister.

default.0: Not everyone is ready to reach the next stage, oh, no!
